name: ProductLaunchReadinessTracker
tagline: Country launch readiness and go/no-go for pharma – in one Power Apps control.
description: Complete pharmaceutical country-launch readiness app: weighted readiness by launch, workstream and gate, critical go/no-go criteria with evidence, dependencies, launch countdown, enforced workflow rules and a go/no-go decision log (go, conditional go, no-go, postpone). Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with built-in demo data.
features: Go / conditional go / no-go recommendation with reasons
Configurable launch gates relative to the launch date
Critical go/no-go criteria with evidence rule
Decision log with override and postpone (shifts all dates)
12 quick filters, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export
controlType: standard (data-set control ProductLaunchReadinessTracker + field control ProductLaunchReadinessTrackerPortal for Power Pages, shared src/app)
